random_choice.name: Uniform Random Domain Value
random_choice.description: Randomly selects an answer from the domain's discrete value candidate pool (120 values per domain).

majority_class.name: Majority Target Value Baseline
majority_class.description: Predicts the mode value observed in the training split. Due to balanced graph construction (degree=3, unique value per relation), distribution is uniform.

heuristic_entity_copier.name: Surface Entity Copier
heuristic_entity_copier.description: Always predicts the query entity name as the answer.

first_value_pointer.name: First In-Context Value Pointer
first_value_pointer.description: Extracts and outputs the first candidate value encountered in the in-context prompt block.

exact_relational_oracle.name: Deterministic In-Context Relational Pointer (Ceiling)
exact_relational_oracle.description: Parses the prompt context graph, matches the queried entity and relation, and copies the bound target value or outputs abstention token when ungrounded.

pretrained_step_800.name: ChakrMicro Pretrained Step-800 Baseline
pretrained_step_800.hypothesis: Lacks parametric memorization of synthetic graph entities (Status D). Expected near 0% without relational in-context copying capacity.

ucip_20_best.name: ChakrMicro UCIP-20 Best Checkpoint
ucip_20_best.hypothesis: Evaluated on teacher-forced likelihood vs free generation. UCIP-20 showed free generation failure at assistant boundary (predicting generic EOS or hallucination); expected free-generation accuracy < 5%.
